books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
favoriteQuotes: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
books.notes: The focus on identity-based habits makes huge sense. Implementing the 2-minute rule.

books.notes: Changed how I think about independence vs sheer luxury. True wealth is freedom of time.

journalEntries.title: Sunday Morning Golden Hour ☕
journalEntries.content: Woke up before the alarm. The light coming through the blinds was this warm amber slice across the rug. Fresh coffee brewed with Ethiopian beans, notes of jasmine and bergamot. Feeling centered and ready for this new season.

journalEntries.title: Found pressed wildflower in my notebook 🌿
journalEntries.content: Found that little sprig of lavender from last spring tucked between page 45 and 46. It still has the faint sweet herbal scent. Reminded me that time moves gently if we notice it.

journalEntries.title: Midnight Ideas & Starry Sky ✨
journalEntries.content: Sketching out ideas for the balcony garden. Thinking of climbing sweet peas on a bamboo trellis and potted dwarf lemon tree. Ideas flowing like water tonight.
